releases.highlight: Hear each checklist group's name before its first item, with a natural sentence pause.
features: The first item begins with the group name followed by Checklist, including when the item is read again.
The A400M takeoff flap setting now explicitly names position 1 in the checklist and its Brian announcement.

releases.highlight: Prepare the A400M for engine start with explicit altimeter, flight-director and altitude settings.
features: Before Engine Start now follows FMGES Setup and contains both altimeters, flight director and autopilot altitude, with matching Brian announcements.
Removed the generic EFIS, FMGES and Takeoff Data steps; NAV Lights now follows Fuel Pumps.

releases.highlight: Follow the streamlined A400M FMGES setup with separate SimBrief imports and refreshed Brian announcements.
features: Flight Details and Fuel & Payload now have separate SimBrief import steps; airport, flight-plan and loading instructions are clearer.
Removed the initial Cargo and Fuel item, company wind request and separate GPS Primary check.

releases.highlight: Follow the completed A400M FMS setup with Brian announcements and spoken operating notes.
features: FMS Setup now includes page references, loading and route options, a company wind request, IRS verification and a block-fuel explanation.
Removed the provisional FMS review markers and enabled speech for all eight setup steps.
fixes: Added T.O CONFIG after takeoff flaps, with a spoken reminder of the button location.

releases.highlight: Prepare the A400M with dedicated Before Engine Start and Before Taxi groups.
features: Cargo and Fuel preparation now opens the checklist; Before Engine Start adds EFIS, FMGES, takeoff data and altimeters.
Before Taxi contains the moved flap setting plus takeoff, taxi and runway turn-off lights, with matching Brian announcements.
After Start is now After Engine Start; the provisional EFIS and FMS Setup steps remain unchanged after Before Engine Start.
fixes: External power now precedes the batteries during electrical power up.
Arming the ground spoilers is an action and no longer carries a Verify cue.

releases.highlight: Follow an expanded A400M startup checklist with updated Brian announcements.
features: Separate APU switches, start timing and engine-start guidance make startup steps more explicit.
After-start checks now include brakes, spoilers, flaps, anti-ice and All Switches Info, with spoken Verify cues for checks.
The renamed EFIS and FMS Setup group retains its eight provisional review-marked steps without speech.

releases.highlight: Maintenance release with no user-visible changes.
features: Checklist appearance, controls, content, and speech remain unchanged.

releases.highlight: Skip a flight phase from the EFB when your aircraft is already prepared.
features: The chapter-skip icon completes all remaining items in the current phase, including optional items, and opens the next phase.
With item speech enabled, the companion reads the next open item after one completion announcement.
After the final phase is completed, the skip button is disabled until an item in that phase is reopened.

releases.highlight: See the flight phase of each checklist group in the EFB and companion.
features: Outlined phase badges are aligned to the right in the EFB and shown in companion checklists and the dashboard.
PDF and text exports include each group's phase, including continued PDF groups.
Escape closes the Checklists, Settings and Release Notes windows.
fixes: Corrected the MH-60 engine speed labels from Ng to NG.

releases.highlight: Switch between VR and desktop without repeating the current checklist announcement.
fixes: New EFB instances restore checklist progress before sending their first state to the companion.

releases.highlight: Follow the checklist with natural English Brian announcements, entirely offline.
features: Read checklist items is enabled by default and remembers your choice.
New items replace outdated speech; group completion finishes before the latest item is read.
The saved Radio effect switch applies a live radio filter; switching it off restores clean speech.
Group completion and Test sound now use Brian, with Test sound independent of simulator connection changes.
Updated MH-60 lighting and APU instructions; verification items include a spoken Verify cue.
The eight provisional A400M FSM Init steps remain silent.

releases.highlight: Choose where checklist announcements play, independently of the Windows default audio output.
features: The Settings dialog remembers your chosen audio device across app restarts.
Recently selected devices appear first, with Windows default always at the top.
Test sound plays Checklist completed on the selected output without changing checklist progress.
Unavailable devices keep their selection until they reconnect or you choose another output.

releases.highlight: Section navigation now sits above the group heading, keeping the heading next to its checklist items.
features: Navigation buttons are about one third shorter while retaining their text size.

releases.highlight: Completed checklist groups carry a green check mark in the EFB, and the companion announces every finished group with a spoken Checklist completed.
features: The group header and the navigation buttons show a green check mark once every item of a group is ticked; group numbers are no longer shown.
The companion plays a Checklist completed announcement on the Windows default output device each time a group is fully ticked, using a placeholder system voice.
The companion status window marks the completed checklist and a completed active group with the same green check mark.
Development builds of the companion show a -dev timestamp suffix in the version; releases keep the plain version.
The transport probe plays the embedded announcement with --play-completion-sound without MSFS.
fixes: The companion reports a missing SimConnect.dll in its status line instead of waiting for MSFS indefinitely.

releases.highlight: Copy an unrecognized aircraft's model identifiers directly from the companion dashboard.
features: A Copy button copies ATC MODEL, ATC TYPE and TITLE when the EFB reports no matching checklist, with brief Copied feedback.

releases.highlight: A minimal Cessna 152 checklist puts takeoff, climb and landing reminders at hand.
features: Adds POH-based flap settings, rotation and approach speeds, normal climb and Vy guidance, and mixture reminders with automatic C152 selection.

releases.highlight: The transport probe proves the CommBus channel with a checklist state request and reports the EFB version, instance, selected checklist and progress from the answering snapshot.
features: The EFB app no longer answers the separate ping message, which no shipped component used.

releases.highlight: The checklist scales with the EFB layout area: mounted tablet and detached panel show the same content in every EFB size, and Small, Medium and Large only change how large it appears.
features: Outside VR, the mounted tablet uses the same compact layout as in VR, while the detached panel shows more content per screen.
All sizes follow one root font size derived from the EFB layout area instead of fixed pixel values.

releases.highlight: A first Airbus A400M checklist covers electrical power up, FSM init, engine start and after start.
features: Adds an Airbus A400M checklist; the FSM init items are marked for review until they are verified in the simulator.

releases.highlight: The Windows companion can save any checklist as a printable A4 PDF in the two-column layout of the source sheets and open it right away.
features: Adds a PDF button to the checklist window: choose a file name, save the checklist as a compact A4 PDF with framed sections and kind-based row colours, and open it in the default PDF viewer.
Checklist titles now name only the aircraft, for example Diamond DA42 instead of Diamond DA42 – Checklist + ATC.

releases.highlight: The Windows companion now carries the EFB checklist mark as its application icon.
features: Shows the EFB checklist mark on a rounded dark tile as EXE, taskbar and window icon instead of the generic .NET icon.

releases.highlight: The OH-6A/H500C before-start flow now switches on the anti-collision lights early and tests the caution and warning lights before the ignition key.
features: Reorders the OH-6A/H500C before-start flow: anti-collision lights after the battery, caution and warning lights test after the cockpit lights, ignition key last.
Notes that the H500C has no avionics switch.
Replaces the OH-6A/H500C throttle advance hint with the torque range to hold while moving the twistgrip to FLIGHT.

releases.highlight: The companion now shows every shipped checklist in a Checklists window and copies it with one click.
features: Adds a Checklists window with a checklist dropdown, the dashboard checklist preselected, and a Copy button that puts the checklist on the clipboard as Markdown-like text.
Gives every companion button an icon.
Moves the OH-6A/H500C before-takeoff lights to position lights and landing light with pitot heat last, and removes the duplicate caution and warning indicator check during engine start.
Turns the engine cool-down of the OH-6A/H500C and H125 shutdowns into a regular action.

releases.highlight: The OH-6A/H500C checklist now follows the revised compact startup flow.
features: Adds explicit starter release, cockpit-lighting and before-takeoff light reminders to the streamlined OH-6A/H500C flow.

releases.highlight: A compact checklist is now available for Taog's Hangar's OH-6A Cayuse and Hughes 500C.
features: Adds a compact common startup, before-takeoff and shutdown checklist for the OH-6A Cayuse and Hughes 500C variants.

releases.highlight: The Windows companion now handles malformed simulator data and shutdown races more reliably.
fixes: Keeps receiving checklist updates after a malformed CommBus packet instead of entering a reconnect loop.
Reports incomplete checklist, group or item snapshots as protocol errors instead of partial status data.
Prevents rare shutdown races when SimConnect calls outlast the bounded exit wait.

releases.highlight: The H125 startup and lighting flow now follows the published aircraft procedures more closely.
features: Adds an explicit day-or-night instrument-lighting selection after battery activation.
Adds a dedicated Before Taxi group with a mandatory taxi-light reminder and separate landing-light choice.
fixes: Moves horn activation after the twist grip reaches FLIGHT and requires at least 340 rotor RPM.
Corrects the generator threshold from 60 to 67 percent N1.

releases.highlight: Release notes are now available directly inside the companion app.
features: Opens a fully offline, scrollable release history from a dedicated button.
Shows each release date, main highlight, features and fixes with the newest version first.

releases.highlight: Checklist state now reaches the companion app with less avoidable CommBus traffic.
fixes: Rate-limited spontaneous checklist snapshots and coalesced bursts to the latest state.
Reset checklist progress when switching between aircraft identities that share a checklist.

releases.highlight: The first Windows companion app shows live checklist status from MSFS 2024.
features: Distinguishes the simulator connection from receipt of EFB checklist state.
Shows aircraft, checklist, active group, next open item, progress and both app versions.
Ships as a directly launchable Windows EXE alongside the MSFS package.

releases.highlight: Checklist items can be confirmed from a keyboard or HOTAS button.
features: Confirms the next open item in the visible group through a user-bound MSFS control.

releases.highlight: The first native, offline VR Checklist app runs inside the MSFS 2024 EFB.
features: Introduced automatic aircraft selection and VR-first checklists for the G36, DA42 and MH-60.
